title: Tarnish
tagline: Every sound gets old. Choose how.

cmd: set -e; D=$(mktemp -d); ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i web/assets/samples/atfs1/tine-piano.m4a -ar 48000 -ac 2 -c:a pcm_s24le $D/dry.wav; build/plugins/tarnish/tarnishrender_artefacts/Release/tarnishrender $D/dry.wav '{out}' --preset 'Warm Studio Tape' --bpm 92 --tail 3 --set stop_time=1.8 --at 18.913 stop=1 > /dev/null; rm -rf $D
